author: reek
body: PHASE 3 re-acquires: the full bring-up runs again (handoff, reset, enumerate, mount) and the phase-2 verdict is written to the file. A working phase 3 proves ownership can be juggled per phase -- the strongest form of the fallback feature.

author: reek
body: Cells 2 and 3 are the vendor and device id of the controller cells 0-39 describe, packed here the way cell 48 packs the per-controller table so the two read as the same kind of number and can be compared by eye.

body: The controller host for the handback: the keyboard's when one enumerated, else the disk's -- on a machine with no USB keyboard the experiment still runs.
